observations: Two retail boxes for a food processor are stacked vertically.
The boxes are wrapped in thin clear plastic film.
The brand 'PINNACLE' and model 'PJ5050B' are printed on the front of the boxes.
Text on the box indicates a '4IN1 FOOD PROCESSOR' including juicer, blender, chopper, and dry mill.
Specifications listed on the box include 600 watts and a 1.25 litre PS jar.
A watermark 'ANYIGOD INVESTMENT NIG' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center.

claims.claim: best brand you can rely on

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, inferior item.
risks.proof: A photo of the box opened showing the actual unit and all listed accessories.

risks.risk: The motor may be non-functional or have a short circuit.
risks.proof: A video showing the device plugged in and the motor running through different speeds.

risks.risk: The plastic jars or blades may be cracked or damaged inside the packaging.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the blender jar, chopper bowl, and mill cup.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual food processor and all its attachments outside of the box.
Video of the device powered on and functioning.
Photo of the base plate of the actual unit to confirm the model and wattage.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identifiable from the retail packaging. While the contents are not shown, the item can be priced at its worst-case scenario (non-functional/parts only) based on the identified model.
